title: Counter loop expansion
statement: Given a number $k$ of work tapes, an index $i<k$, and a finite Boolean pattern, construct a machine with $k+1$ work tapes and Boolean work-tape symbols. Its states are the loop states carrying states of the machine that writes the pattern while advancing on tape $i$; the constructed machine runs the counter loop around that writer, with the counter initialized to $0$ and no designated exit state.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number $k$ of work tapes
